faq_heading: Port Moody Townhomes for Sale: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built from the boards' September 2026 statistics, the monthly SnapStats figures and Jared's MLS® closed sales (Nov 2025 to Oct 2026). No live feed filtered to this home type yet.

Port Moody townhomes for sale: ground-level homes in strata buildings. The Greater Vancouver REALTORS® benchmark for townhomes in Port Moody was $940,900 in September 2026 (-5.2% over a year). Before you offer, read the strata documents: the depreciation report, meeting minutes, bylaws and fees.
Port Moody townhomes sold, November 2025 to October 2026

111 townhomes sold in Port Moody with a median price of $945,000 (the middle half sold between $826,000 and $1,179,000), taking a median of 18 days to sell at 98.0% of the last list price; 3% sold above list. They had a median $599 per square foot, a median year built of 1992 and a median strata fee of $479 a month.

items.t: Port Moody real estate market stats

faq.q: What did townhomes in Port Moody sell for?
faq.a: 111 townhomes sold in Port Moody between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $945,000.

faq.q: How long do townhomes take to sell in Port Moody?
faq.a: The median was 18 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 98.0% of the last list price (3% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most townhomes in Port Moody sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 111 townhomes that sold in Port Moody went for between $826,000 and $1,179,000, around a median of $945,000.

faq.q: Do townhomes in Port Moody sell above asking price?
faq.a: 3% of the 111 townhomes sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 98.0% of it.

faq.q: What is a typical strata fee for townhomes in Port Moody?
faq.a: Of the 111 sales, 110 listings gave a monthly fee and the median was $479.

faq.q: How old are the townhomes that sold in Port Moody?
faq.a: The median year built was 1992 for the 111 townhomes sold in Port Moody.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do townhomes in Port Moody usually have?
faq.a: The median townhome that sold in Port Moody had 3 bedrooms, from the 111 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Which Port Moody communities sold the most townhomes?
faq.a: By number sold: Port Moody Centre (31), College Park PM (27), North Shore Pt Moody (21), for November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Which Port Moody buildings sold the most townhomes?
faq.a: By number sold: Easthill (8), Woodside Village (5), Eagle Point (5), for November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What is the benchmark price of a townhome in Port Moody?
faq.a: The Greater Vancouver REALTORS® MLS® Home Price Index benchmark for townhomes in Port Moody was $940,900 in September 2026, a modelled price for a typical home and not an average of sales.

faq.q: Did townhome prices fall in Port Moody?
faq.a: Over the past year the benchmark fell 5.2%. Over three months it fell 5.3%. A change under 1.5% is not described as a rise or fall.

faq.q: Is Port Moody a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026 houses in Port Moody had a sales ratio of 11%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market, and condos and townhomes 15%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many townhomes are for sale in Port Moody?
faq.a: The listing feed on this page shows what is active now, and the number changes daily. Ask Jared and he will send you the townhomes in Port Moody that match what you want.
